title: Sebastian and the Border
author: Edmund Amberdale
blurb: Petra Thornbury, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
